name: Shopware
needs: an extension or a paid edition

invoices.text: {{check}} Built in: invoices, credit notes and cancellation invoices, with e-invoices

omnibus.text: A field you fill in by hand; working it out needs an extension

withdrawal.text: {{check}} A withdrawal form in the core since 6.7.9.0; the merchant checks exclusions by hand

gpsr.text: Through custom fields, or an extension

vat.text: Rates per country; VAT by the buyer's country through an extension

vies.text: The number's format is checked; a VIES check needs an extension

b2b.text: On the Evolve edition; prices per customer on Beyond

email.text: Event emails built in; newsletters through an extension

ai.text: {{check}} Copilot in every edition; more AI on the paid editions

mobilepay.text: Through an extension, such as Mollie's

strengths.text: You want open source under the MIT licence, hosted and changed by your own team
You sell in Germany and want e-invoices and the withdrawal form in the free core
You need large B2B wholesale: roles, quotes, budgets and approvals on its paid editions
You run many storefronts from one installation, each with its own languages and domains
You want to choose between hosting it yourself, PaaS and SaaS

title: Kaizena Flow compared with Shopware

seo.title: Kaizena Flow vs Shopware: compared for EU shops
seo.description: How Kaizena Flow compares with Shopware for EU shops: the EU's rules, more ways to sell, AI, and what needs an extension, checked on Shopware's own pages.

heroRest: The legal side of EU selling, more ways to sell and an AI that runs the shop come with Flow. Here is how it compares with Shopware, line by line.

faq.q: Can I move my Shopware shop to Flow?
faq.bold: Yes, and we do it for you.
faq.rest: As part of getting you started, we move your shop free of charge. You can also copy pages from your live site and check your old links yourself.

faq.q: Do I need extensions to get what the Flow column shows?
faq.rest: Everything in the Flow column is part of Flow. Owning several stores starts on the Grow plan.
Your store's database and servers are in Dublin, Ireland.

faq.q: Is it safe to let the AI work on its own?
faq.bold: You decide how much it does.
faq.rest: Refunds, emails to your whole list, changes to your staff and your domain always wait for your yes, and every change it makes is in the activity log.
